title: [FREE Early Access] A browser sandbox for AI game building (bash.tv) — looking for feedback
author: mellamofionaa
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev !!!

We are opening up early access to [Bash.tv](http://Bash.tv), a browser-based creative coding platform designed to make prototyping and building games with AI fast and collaborative.   
  
The core idea is giving you an instant sandbox where you can prompt, tweak code directly, and test playable games without dealing with heavy engine setups or deployment pipelines.

While we are in early access, it is **completely free to build** using our free model. We are sharing it here because we want feedback from people actively experimenting with AI in game dev to help shape where the tool goes next.

People are already building lot of cool shit too! And it's more than just games.

We would love your honest thoughts as we build our community of game devs, creatives, artists, and normies just wanted to make stuff. We are also hosting weekly sessions to learn more about game dev and the platform with one of the co-founders. 

Join our Discord to grab your free invite code: [https://bit.ly/4xcA1bo](https://bit.ly/4xcA1bo)

Drop any feedback, wishlist features, or just a hi in our server. 

Looking forward to growing our [Bash.tv](http://Bash.tv) community!
